title: Procurement Re-Order Notice: Surcharge on Reinstated Design Studio Selections Lines
content:
The re-order surcharge on a reinstated Design Studio Selections line is set by the construction stage of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves:

| Construction stage on the Home Purchase Agreement | Re-order surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|
| Framing, drywall, finishes or complete | 250.00 |
| Foundation | 125.00 |
| Any other stage | Nothing |

**Records read.** The current construction stage on the Home Purchase Agreement.

*Hypothetical cases:* reinstatement while the agreement shows foundation adds 125.00; at finishes, 250.00; before construction starts, nothing.
